Undisclosed blanks the participant must fill before this is filable: (1) the proposed order's law-enforcement service list on page 14, 32 printed rules, 240 by 408 points, refused by the build and disclosed nowhere -- and contradicted by step 8, see SERVICE; (2) the petition's WHEREFORE agency blanks on page 5, items 1(b) through 1(e), which name the county sheriff's department and up to three further agencies whose records the court is asked to order removed -- the guide's blanks table lists page 5 only for the two election squares and the signature line; (3) the same three LEA blanks reproduced on order page 12. The build's own record classifies (2) and (3) as 'no_allowlisted_fact_matches', which is a reason the platform did not write them, not a disclosure to the person who must. A silent blank on a proposed order is the failure this obligation exists to catch, and it is present.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Measured on the delivered bytes and cross-checked against each widget's own option list rather than against extracted line order. The route requires no pre-made election: petition paragraph 1 of the WHEREFORE asks for agency removal unconditionally, and the two squares beneath it (Check Box9, Check Box10) elect additional relief -- sealing the sentencing, juvenile, Court of Appeals and Supreme Court records, and appellate cause numbers -- which this route neither compels nor holds a value for. Both are unmarked, both print as an empty square identical to the source, and both appear in the guide's blanks table by name with the instruction 'mark the relief you are asking the court to order'. DD-cap-CourtType is a genuine option field the platform declines to choose because no held record says which court holds the case; that refusal is disclosed in four separate places in the guide. The eight FINDINGS squares on insert page 3 are the court's and the guide says so.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: MEASURED, AND THERE ARE TWO REAL REPEATING TABLES HERE. Both resolved by geometry against the printed page, never by AcroForm suffix. (1) The Appearance RELATED CASES table, six Caption/CauseNumber pairs on bundle pages 1-2, every cell blank on this route and disclosed in the guide as 'six Caption and Case No. pairs'; the build additionally refuses CauseNumber1-6 by role, because writing this matter's own cause number into row 1 would file an Appearance stating the case is related to itself. (2) The insert form's offence grid, counts 1-4, printed on page 1 and repeated on page 3. Read from the census: DD-ChargeLevel-Ct1 y 538.23, OffenseDescript-Ct1 537.96, DD-Misd/Felony-Ct1 537.93, DD-LevelChoice-Ct1 537.65 form one horizontal band; Ct2 at 523.43-522.85; Ct3 at 509.76-509.18; Ct4 at 495.53-494.95. Four bands in descending page order, each carrying exactly one cell per column, and every suffix sits in the band its number implies, so no cell matches none or more than one row. Columns read by x-position -- 81.83 description, 356.63 level choice, 399.74 charge level, 449.56 misdemeanour-or-felony -- match the printed column order at 200 dpi. Every cell is blank, so no charge can land on another charge's line. The erasure of those cells' printed rules is a real harm to a participant filling them in by hand and is counted under CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP and visualDefects, not twice here.
REPEATING_ROWS.howMeasured: Widget rectangles read from field-census.census-v1.json and sorted by y then x; column order confirmed against a 200 dpi crop of the printed grid; every cell confirmed blank on the delivered bytes.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Nothing fabricated and nothing quoted that is not there. The committed registry track carries rules.fees 'None. Section 1 petitions carry no filing fee.' and rules.feeWaiver 'Not applicable. There is no fee.', and destination.detail repeats 'No filing fee.' The guide's 'What it costs' section reproduces the first two as quotations and both strings are present in the registry object, checked directly. The guide then draws the correct practical conclusion -- because there is no fee there is nothing to have waived -- and instead of inventing a clerk's practice it tells the participant that if a clerk asks for payment they should ask what the charge is for before paying. No amount, no waiver form and no clerk's practice is asserted anywhere.
